changeSet.sql: UPDATE oc_saga AS checkout SET created_at = audit.placed_at FROM ( SELECT aggregate_id, MIN(occurred_at) AS placed_at FROM common_financial_audit WHERE context = 'ordercheckout' AND action IN ('FREE_CHECKOUT_COMPLETED', 'PAID_CHECKOUT_AWAITING_PAYMENT') GROUP BY aggregate_id ) AS audit WHERE checkout.id = audit.aggregate_id
